scope: Sierra Magina hiking catalog closure status

official_park_inventory.source_name: Junta de Andalucia - Ventana del Visitante
official_park_inventory.note: Closed means the official signposted-trail inventory is identified. It does not mean every route track is geometry-validated or publicly publishable.

exception_notes: Larva is audited, but no named official pedestrian route with a dedicated technical sheet/track was located. No route is invented to force 16/16 route presence.

provincial_hiking_network.source_name: Diputacion de Jaen - Jaen Paraiso Interior
provincial_hiking_network.validation_note: R1-R9 official pages are recorded independently from track geometry validation. R5 is source-documented to km 16.7 and R8 to km 20.9; R4/R5/R8 still lack an authoritative downloadable track in the current audit.

official_programmed_hikes_2026.source_name: Diputacion de Jaen - Jaen Paraiso Interior
official_programmed_hikes_2026.note: Programmed hikes are official curated activities but are not automatically treated as permanent signposted trails. Canonical overlaps are recorded where known.

homologated_network.source_name: Federacion Andaluza de Deportes de Montana, Escalada y Senderismo
homologated_network.safety_note: GR-7 remains homologated in the federation listing, while the Jaen route page warns that no maintenance has been notified since 1998 and describes scarce/deteriorated signage.

track_validation.rule: track_found is not track_validated; geometry validation requires inspectable geometry, identity match, sanity checks, method and date evidence.

requirements: Every publishable route must have a real track.
Every publishable route track must be geometry-validated.
Every validated track must have an evidence log with validation method and date.
Technical distance/elevation/duration values must be sourced or derived from validated geometry with documented methodology.
Current closures/incidents must remain independent from catalog publication state.
Duplicate or overlapping Junta/Diputacion/GR-PR-SL records must preserve provenance and canonical relationships instead of being silently merged.
publication_gate.reason_not_closed: Several official, municipal and provincial tracks are located but not geometry-validated; R4/R5/R8 still lack an authoritative downloadable track in the current audit; some municipal routes still lack complete technical sheets or authoritative downloadable tracks.
